purpose: Test whether observations from the frozen original workloads recur on other native inputs under a shared execution workflow.

executor_split.description: Executor version and the byte-preserved workload are frozen separately; the unified runner is the formal entry for every dataset and old opm/tlc keep the original loop/timing semantics.

path_policy: Original venv prefix by default for BOTH baselines and added workloads; explicit system mode restores original system PATH; never inject runtime/bin/soffice.
skills_policy: Use installed byte-preserved document-oe PDF/XLSX tools including its isolated-profile recalc.py.

pdf.driver: one Python batch driver, alternating one fill and one render per record
pdf.selection: Prepare all frozen records; fill/render first 1 or 10 according to variant and native parameter
pdf.mapping_precheck: one common field-ID check; no separate SBA dry-run helper
pdf.verification: Check all prepared mappings and exactly the selected PDFs and renders

xlsx.recalc_target: the final output workbook; original Skill recalc.py recalculates it in place so LibreOffice saves the computed caches directly
xlsx.enhancement_helper: written and run through the generic atomic XLSX helper; enhances the final output workbook directly

strict: original data values and missing/suppression markers
original formulas and chart data series/references
LibreOffice recalc success and required cached values
diagnostics: style table / relationship ID / shared strings representation
empty-string cells normalized to empty cells

measurement.native_iteration: Original run_iteration elapsed time includes workspace reset, four phases and original final status read.
measurement.net_iteration: Native iteration elapsed time minus native reset_seconds.
measurement.stage_times: Original native execute_step boundaries, including each phase's actual helper calls.
measurement.verification_caveat: Native verify_deliver is included, but dataset-specific semantic verifiers differ; compare it separately.
measurement.instrumentation: Either original plain mode for both sides or original timed wrapper for both sides. No per-call stdout redirection added.

trace_policy.classification: canonicalized deterministic replay derived from successful Agent executions; not a newly generated Agent trajectory
trace_policy.positioning_note: Execution-structure alignment and functional passing do not prove representativeness. Standardized recipes are not faithful call-for-call replays of the original Agent final implementation, and input differences must not be attributed to industry effects without covariate evidence.

interpretation.supported_question: Does an observed bottleneck or system-configuration trend persist for other inputs using this workflow?
not_established_by_qualification: all Office or unconstrained Agent workloads

loop_policy.native_loops: requested loops, uninterrupted by outer acceptance or archival
loop_policy.independent_acceptance: once after all native iterations succeed
loop_policy.archive: final iteration only; all native iteration logs retained
